content: The Avon Walk for Breast Cancer is a fundraising initiative aimed at supporting the Avon Foundation in its efforts to research and develop a cure for breast cancer. The walk spans a distance of 3 miles. This event was first organized in 2003 and is currently held in eight cities across the United States. These cities include Washington, D.C., Boston, Chicago, Denver, San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, and Charlotte. In 2008, the walk will expand to include Houston, Texas, as a new location. The Houston event is scheduled to take place in early April. In 2006, the Avon Walk for Breast Cancer saw participation from over 22,000 individuals, collectively raising more than $42 million to support breast cancer research and related initiatives.
